content: Thanks @Ruben Van de Velde for helping with the bump to 4.29. I merged your PR (I realised this time that you were PRing to my branch). I'm working on it now for another couple of hours (until about 2026-04-04T16:00:00+01:00 ) and then I'll post an update.

Here is an up to date list of the files which are not compiling in the bump branch FLT#877 (although of course when these are fixed, maybe more files won't compile).

- FLT.Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Ring.WithAbs
- FLT.Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Valued.WithZeroMulInt
- FLT.DedekindDomain.AdicValuation

I'll go through these one by one.

Task 1) FLT/Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Ring/WithAbs.lean : this is very broken because WithAbs has become a one field structure in mathlib. @Salvatore Mercuri when we spoke about this on Thursday you suggested that a bunch of this file had been upstreamed. Do you have any opinions on the mess that this file has become? I got the impression that you were confident that a lot of the material here should have been upstreamed.

Task 2) FLT/Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Valued/WithZeroMulInt.lean: this is broken because of the changes currently happening in the valuation part of mathlib. It seems to me that we now have docs#ValuativeRel.ValueGroupWithZero and docs#MonoidWithZeroHom.ValueGroup₀ which perhaps used to be defeq and are now isomorphic via docs#ValuativeRel.ValueGroupWithZero.orderMonoidIso . So some proofs in this file need rewriting.

DONE Task 3) FLT/GlobalLanglandsConjectures/GLnDefs.lean. This is not needed for FLT and actually I hope to start an independent push to state the global Langlands conjectures elsewhere. However it is in the FLT code base currently, and the issue is a slightly weird

failed to synthesize instance of type class
  HasQuotient (↥(Z (GL (Fin n) ℝ) (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)))
    (Submodule ℂ ↥(Z (GL (Fin n) ℝ) (Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)))

where 

def Z := Subalgebra.center ℂ (Alg G E)

. The error is in fact in the middle of the definition of a structure some of whose fields are stubbed out anyway, so we could just stub this out too if nobody can instantly spot what's gone wrong. This is low priority -- not needed in FLT and incomplete code anyway.

Task 4) FLT/DedekindDomain/AdicValuation.lean. This is a victim of the fact that WithVal v is no longer defeq to K (again it's become a one field structure) so again a bunch of proofs need fixing. @Salvatore Mercuri any hints?

DONE Task 5) FLT/Mathlib/RingTheory/DedekindDomain/FiniteAdeleRing.leanA definition of a continuous linear map has broken; the proof of continuity was omitted in 4.28 but now fun_prop no longer solves it, for some reason (this is not the only time in the file that this has happened; I fixed all the other problems but couldn't immediately do this one). I have left a partial proof where I unfold everything.

Obviously all this is my problem but I am unlikely to have any more time to work on this today Saturday. I want to avoid duplication of work so if someone wants to have a go at PRing to the bump branch then please feel free but maybe you want to flag which file you're working on in this thread. Obviously at this point I'm very happy to accept set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false -- my main goal is to get the bump over the line at this point.
I won't be working on it for at least 24 hours
Now down to 3 broken files and I'm going to bed for 8 or so hours

The stuff in WithAbs.lean is pretty much now all in mathlib. There are then further dependent issues in various InfinitePlace files which need fixing, but these are also either in mathlib or are in an open PR of mine, so I should be able to easily fix those by copying any PR material back in. I'll take that task!
Or would you rather we merged your open PR first? Happy either way

Oh yes, good point. Might be a good idea to get that in on Friday morning and then we can finalise the bump afterwards. I've almost finished up with the WithAbs issues, but I won't be able to do any further today, so I'll finish that off tomorrow!
I have finished fixing up WithAbs and dependent files, although I tried to push and realise that I don't have permission to push to the PR. Shall I create a separate draft PR?
Maybe make a PR to the PR? That's what Ruben did. Thanks a lot!

Thanks! I merged the PR (cleanly) and now there are merge conflicts in #877 (wrt main). Is it safe to just talk about these on Friday in our meeting?

I have to give one talk tomorrow and one talk the day after, so most of my time is being sucked into this, but I think I need a break so will work on FLT/Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Valued/WithZeroMulInt.lean now. This is one of the two remaining broken files.
OK there are still problems in this file and I need to get back to writing my talks. The issue is that a whole bunch of Multiplicative (WithZero Int)s have become MonoidWithZeroHom.ValueGroup₀ v

Kevin Buzzard said:

Thanks! I merged the PR (cleanly) and now there are merge conflicts in #877 (wrt main). Is it safe to just talk about these on Friday in our meeting?

I think the bump PR is missing the PR that we merged last week, so that might be the source of conflicts. But yes we can discuss those on Friday

Kevin Buzzard said:

OK there are still problems in this file and I need to get back to writing my talks. The issue is that a whole bunch of Multiplicative (WithZero Int)s have become MonoidWithZeroHom.ValueGroup₀ v

Thankfully 2/3 errors in that file are for theorems that have been upstreamed to mathlib

Thanks to @Ruben Van de Velde and especially to @Salvatore Mercuri we are now on v4.29!

We also have a host of technical debt (which I guess will be slowly solved over time, I made no attempt to remove most of the backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency falses) and also a bunch of slowdowns (caused, I think, by the fact that WithVal is now a one-field structure). I have been actively trying to understand the slowdowns here #mathlib4 > instance unfolding phenomenon @ 💬 but still no silver bullet.
